boundaries.read: Question text/family/stratum metadata and pilot annotation guides; pilot adjudicated-v2 used for question text only.

coverage_result: PASS: 96 new training questions and30 development questions; each of six primary strata has16 new training and5 development questions. Pilot has24 additional training questions; combined training is120. Counts do not establish family independence or annotation quality.

cross_split_findings.rationale: T003/T004 request observing expression-driven label changes; D013 gives the subscription/event API and D018 changes only version/generalizes the property. The extra unsubscribe ask does not make the observation component independent. D030 also shares this operation but adds a genuine comparison; include it in the conservative family closure.

Both ask how to read a named model property inside an expression. D014 specializes the model to field.parent.model and changes the property name. That adds path specificity but does not make an independent scenario family.

Two entities of the same kind are introduced followed by an operation on an ambiguous demonstrative/pronoun. D021 substitutes buttons/hiding for groups/resetting or moving. This is meaningful template overlap for a reference-resolution task, even though domain scenarios differ. Include clear counterpart IDs T067/T068/D022 if this family is used as a strict template holdout.

All have deictic references whose antecedents are absent. D025 changes the operation but remains the same missing-context template. This is pilot-to-dev as well as newtrain-to-dev template overlap; it is not a near-verbatim duplicate. A scenario-only split could permit it but must explicitly disclaim template independence.

cross_split_related_but_not_proven_leaka.rationale: All concern options replacement but dependent country/city invalidation and explaining disappearance differ from remote loading/error handling; do not equate broad topic overlap with paraphrase leakage.

Repeated-group configuration overlaps; D015 asks container-versus-item type attribution with exact code names. Conservative array-configuration grouping is possible, but not a demonstrated paraphrase.
Read-only label versus read-only model preview plus no-copy constraint. Related display topic, insufficient evidence of a common paraphrase family.
Focus behavior overlaps but insertion without stealing focus and explicitly setting focus on an existing named field are distinct scenarios.

same_split_family_merges.rationale: Positive insertion/focus and negative no-focus variants share the scenario.
Reset invocation and model targets recur as multi-aspect and ordinary questions.
Scope-added versions of initialize and cleanup callback questions.
Group class placement/rendering variants across exact identifiers, Bootstrap scope and ordinary requests.
Ambiguous/clear variants differ principally by whether the group antecedent is unique.
Generic FormlyFieldConfig custom-props typing with substituted names/Unicode identifier.
Suffix/prefix is a minimal-pair component substitution under the same scoped input scenario.
Wrapper registration/removal requests recur with named/ambiguous references, scope comparisons and no-template constraints; a conservative family covers these partially overlapping asks.
Ordinary custom-type registration and explicitly scoped core registration are scope variants.
Attach a registered validator using either exact configuration syntax or a resolved reference.
Description computation plus no-mutation versus configuring the explicit expression path.
The same blur-triggered model update request with exact API syntax versus Angular/Formly scope.
Ambiguous/clear button-hiding pair; D022 adds submission condition.
Exact API, version scope, and comparison variants of observing field/expression change.
Server-error attachment/clearing and no-repeat-check constraints share error reporting.

question_quality_findings.detail: A tab contains a panel; that container can describe both. The closest noun panel is a plausible conversational reading, so adjudication must explain why specificity does or does not resolve it. Do not infer intended UI semantics.
Which one refers to initial/current values, but this has no operation or object antecedent at all. Record both uncertainties rather than treating it as a simple two-value choice.
How do I choose that value may mean choose between default/server values; that value is still not unique. It should not be silently converted to a resolved selection goal.
It may mean the form as well as either section; rationale should not limit candidates to only the two sections.

Prevent editing can mean read-only, disabled cell or interaction restriction. This is an open implementation request, not necessarily a needs_clarification reference; avoid importing a disabled API label.
A read-only preview is a requested display behavior, not an explicit props.readonly API token. No-copy constraint applies to the preview operation.

question_quality_findings.issue: Custom type provenance absent by design
question_quality_findings.detail: repeat-block is a supplied custom registration name, not proof of built-in Formly behavior. Container-versus-fieldArray wording is intelligible without executing or verifying that component.

question_quality_findings.issue: Requested capability is not an established fact
question_quality_findings.detail: Observe reset completion, expose request error, and recompute summary are asks; labels must not invent built-in reset events, request APIs or summary components.
No adapter is explicit. Preserve that lack of scope rather than assume Material or mark the question ambiguous merely because behavior depends on implementation.

resolved-option combines option selection and validator attachment; resolved-control combines error inspection and description replacement; resolved-model combines model reading and wrapper registration. Current names encode a reference category rather than an actual scenario family. Use scenario family IDs and separate reference-form tags.

question_quality_findings.issue: Coverage counts overstate independent scenario breadth
question_quality_findings.detail: Newtrain uses eight two-question families per stratum and highly regular sentence templates. Report independent family counts after transitive merging; 16 questions is not16 independent scenarios. Whole-dataset grammatical diversity is not established by quota balance.

recommended_repair: Assign connected-component family IDs across pilot + newtrain + dev first; move or replace all members of blocking cross-split components together, then recheck primary quotas and affected annotations. Do not solve leakage by merely renaming family strings. Retain scope, reference-form and stratum as separate tags. Template-level findings require an explicit split policy if retained.
limits: This audit identifies overlap only in the observed24 pilot +96 newtrain +30dev questions. It neither reads nor verifies sealed evaluation questions, older exposed diagnostic sets, or historical contamination. Even after observed family repair, absence of identified leakage cannot establish absence of sealed-evaluation/exposed-history contamination.

replacement_assessment.candidate: How do I set props.attributes['data-testid'] to 'customer-input'?
replacement_assessment.assessment: No identified family overlap with observed pilot/train; retain exact nested identifier/literal annotation review.

replacement_assessment.candidate: In Formly 7, how do I supply an accessible name for a custom widget?
replacement_assessment.assessment: No identified scenario-family overlap with observed pilot/train; version-scope grammar is shared but not alone a scenario-family match.

replacement_assessment.candidate: The field has two validators named 'range'. Which 'range' does the message belong to?
replacement_assessment.assessment: Not preferred under strict template separation: P11 asks about two field occurrences sharing key 'city'. Both challenge identity through duplicate names, despite different entity kinds.

replacement_assessment.candidate: Before it is displayed, how can I format the summary?
replacement_assessment.assessment: Novel forward-reference/cataphora construction versus observed pilot/train; stratum permits resolved references. Merge with D005 within dev as computed-summary. Does not preserve an unresolved-ambiguity subquota if one is separately required.

template_policy_note: D021 is a direct same-kind two-candidate pronoun template reuse. D023 instead introduces nested different-kind containers and resolves a hypernym; no direct pilot/train paraphrase identified, so retain with D024 in one dev family. Sharing grammar such as version-prefixed questions is not alone family leakage; the relation/operation pattern and replaced slots matter.
